card.name: Linking words in all-caps warning text
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as AND, BE, OTHER, INCLUDING, or a closing parenthesis inside ALL-CAPS boxed warning text. They often come in lists of emergency treatments or resuscitation items.

modes.label: Linking words in emergency treatment lists
modes.description: AND, OTHER, INCLUDING or BE in capitalized lists of resuscitation drugs and equipment.
modes.example: RESUSCITATIVE EQUIPMENT, OXYGEN AND OTHER RESUSCITATIVE DRUGS SHOULD<< BE>> AVAILABLE FOR IMMEDIATE USE.

modes.label: Other capitalized warning phrases
modes.description: A joining word or word ending in other all-caps label text, such as dilution instructions or section headings.
modes.example: FOVIR INJECTION, USP MUST BE DILUTED IN 100 MILLILITERS 0.9% (NORMAL<<)>> SALINE PRIOR TO ADMINISTRATION.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward predicting capitalized word starts like ST, LA, UN, and MA, which fits all-caps text.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in all-capital warning text, especially lists of emergency treatments.
